question: Which of the following is **NOT** a kharif crop?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mustard__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mustard **is **not a Kharif crop.**
 
• **Kharif crops** are domesticated plants that are **cultivated and harvested in the monsoon season**, which lasts from **June to November depending on the area.** 
 
• **The Rabi crops** are those which are grown in the winter season from **November and are harvested in April.**
 
• **Zaid crops** are such crops that are **grown between the Kharif and Rabi** seasons, i.e **between March and June**.
